name: Abul Kashem
role: Intellectual Founder of the Language Movement
contribution: Through Tamaddun Majlish, he helped launch the earliest organized campaign for Bangla as a state language of Pakistan.
context: Dhaka's post-partition intellectual and student circles, especially from 1947 onward.
impact: He provided one of the movement's first coherent intellectual frameworks and helped move language into formal public politics.
